meta.title: Cross-Harness Crash-to-Lesson Correlation Timeline
meta.subtitle: Illustrative operational scenario: how Number One preserves intermediate failures across a harness switch and auto-captures a verified Lesson

events.title: Test Suite Crashes (exit 1)
events.detail: n1 exec -- npm test records exec.failed with signature 'TypeError: headers.get is not a function'.

events.title: Dead-End Approach Recorded
events.detail: Agent logs attempt.failed: polyfilling global Headers broke Node undici streaming.

events.title: Context Compacted & Harness Switched
events.detail: Operator switches to Claude Code; MCP consult_number_one surfaces both the crash and the dead-end.

events.title: Targeted Fix Applied
events.detail: WorkspaceFsWatcher records fs.modified on src/utils/http.ts normalizing plain object headers.

events.title: Tests Pass & Auto-Lesson Synthesized
events.detail: exec.completed triggers detectFailureToFixCorrelation, automatically recording lesson.captured with root cause and dead-ends.
